report_only.summary: Agent may report status only. No brief generation, no worktree, no implementation.

brief_allowed.summary: Agent may generate a scoped phase brief. No implementation.

worktree_allowed.summary: Agent may recommend or create a worktree only after an explicit command. No implementation unless separately allowed.

docs_eval_autofix_allowed.summary: Agent may make docs/eval-only changes in an isolated worktree, verify, and wait for human merge approval.

implementation_requires_approval.summary: Agent may plan and prepare a brief. Human approval is required before code or runtime changes.

human_required.summary: Agent may only document or checklist the issue. Provider, account, credential, or other human action is required.

blocked.summary: Agent must not act. This includes destructive cleanup, secret printing, unapproved database writes, or side-effect enablement.

pending-human.reason: Finding status requires manual human or provider action.

resolved.reason: Resolved findings should only be reported.

deferred.reason: Deferred findings should only be reported.

keywordRules.reason: Finding text requests or implies a forbidden side effect.
Finding requires provider/account action that an agent cannot safely perform.
Finding touches a high-risk product boundary and needs explicit implementation approval.

eval-update.reason: Eval fixture updates can be docs/eval-only when they avoid live services and side effects.

docs-only.reason: Docs-only findings can be handled as docs/eval changes when scoped to documentation artifacts.

desktop.reason: Desktop and Electron changes may affect packaging, process management, or local permissions.

backend.reason: Backend runtime changes require explicit approval after a brief.

mobile.reason: Mobile runtime and storage changes require explicit approval after a brief.

multi.reason: Multi-repo changes require explicit coordination and approval after a brief.

P1.reason: P1 findings may generate briefs but require approval for runtime changes.

P2.reason: P2 docs/eval/tooling findings may allow docs/eval autofix when no runtime boundary is touched.
